about_the_game:
2024 Season Pack 5 is here and with it the final 2 LMGT3’s and 1 track to compete the 2024 Season in Le Mans Ultimate!

A refined GT3 contender – the Lexus RC F LMGT3 brings Japanese engineering and consistency to the FIA World Endurance Championship. Featuring a naturally aspirated 5.4-liter V8, the RC F boasts robust reliability and a muscular presence, with a focus on aerodynamic stability and tire management across long stints.

In 2024, the RC F LMGT3 made its FIA WEC debut with Akkodis ASP, marking Lexus’s return to top-tier global endurance racing. Although being the oldest car on the grid, the Lexus still blends sharp design with race-proven durability and the team’s methodical performance and race craft make it a serious LMGT3 threat.

The Lamborghini Huracán LMGT3 Evo2 is evolution of a proven performer and builds on the marque’s GT3 pedigree with revised aerodynamics, improved cooling, and enhanced drivability for endurance racing. Introduced for the 2023 racing season and refined for 2024, the Evo2 features Lamborghini’s signature V10 power and aggressive styling.

Making its debut in the 2024 FIA World Endurance Championship, the Huracán LMGT3 Evo2 was campaigned by Iron Lynx and Iron Dames, showcasing some promising results in the ultra-competitive LMGT3 class including a podium in the 6 Hours of Spa-Francorchamps.

Although not competing in the 2025 season, the Lamborghini with standout liveries and Italian flair, is still a fan-favorite with serious intent.

Lusail International Circuit (LIC), located on the outskirts of Doha, Qatar, is a premier motorsports venue renowned for hosting top-tier events such as Formula 1, MotoGP, and the FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC). The circuit spans 5.38 km and features 16 turns, offering multiple configurations including the Full GP Circuit, Fast Loop, and Academy Loop to accommodate various events & races - both the GP and short Academy loop will be replicated in LMU.

Lusail made its debut in the FIA World Endurance Championship in 2024, hosting the Qatar 1812 KM race, named in honor of Qatar's National Day. The event featured a 10 hour endurance race that began in daylight and concluded under the circuit's iconic floodlights. Porsche Penske Motorsport secured victory in this inaugural race. Following the success of the 2024 event, Lusail hosted the WEC season opener again in 2025, solidifying its status as a key venue in the endurance racing calendar.

Time to go racing, 2024 style!

 
Content (expected release 10th June)

  • Lamborghini Huracan LMGT3 Evo2

  • Lexus RC F LMGT3

  • Lusail International Circuit (Qatar)
